comments.author: @gocubsgo721
comments.text: FedEx ground is the bottom of the barrel for delivery work. They pay the least, do the most stops, and lift the heaviest packages. Imagine an 18 foot truck filled front-to-back with 7 foot boxes that weigh up to 150 lbs. There's so many packages all over the floor & walls that you can't even maneuver inside of the truck-- it's completely unorganized, packages are flying off the shelves while driving, and 60% of the total packages are oversized and weigh 70 pounds minimum. You also have to do pickups where you load more inventory into an already clustered truck. Some of the trucks don't have backup camera's, leak brake fluid, and brakes are known to go out. Someone is driving that truck the next day. The contractors truly do not care about your safety at all. There's no AC inside of the trucks either, which is absolutely brutal during heat waves. I worked 2 weeks at this job and I hated every second of it. Amazon is way easier, more organized, less weight, and pays more. Plus their vans are new/nice. I'm glad I went back to Amazon.

comments.author: @beardedbro8466
comments.text:
Worked for FedEx for 2 weeks as a driver. 
2025. 
Paid me 17 an hr. 
120 stops a day. 
Hauling heavy 100lb packages up half mile driveways
No ac in trucks
You load your own truck
They sometimes have a few things in your truck but most of it is laying behind your truck. 
It was 7am till you finish. 
Here's the catch. If you get assigned a box that doesn't empty till 6pm doesn't matter if you finish at 3 or 4 you have to wait and pick it up at 6pm or after. They won't allow you to pick it up early. 
 Then you have to go to one of the FedEx shipping offices and pickup everything everyone has wanted mailed that day. 
Then go back to terminal and unload all those boxes. 
Then you get to go home. 

I'm in shape and am pretty strong, it was gruling and they don't care about you. I didn't even get an ID or shirt before I quit.

This job should pay 30an hr minimum. You will destroy your body in a year. Don't chase money over health, cause later you will try to use money to get health back.
